items.label: MATERIAL & STRUCTURE
items.value: Made from Durable waterproof non-woven fabric tiers , Strengthened plastic connectors and thickened iron pipes. Short design of shelf pipes are hard to bend even put larger & heavy objects, that makes this rack sturdier, stabler and longer lifetime.

items.label: STORE CAPACITY
items.value: 10-tier rack can hold up 20 to 25 pairs of adult shoes, You can remove one layer to fit boots, high heels. This rack is not only for shoes, but also for bags, toys, towel, sundries, books, plants and small accessories.

items.label: MEASURES
items.value: 17 "L x 11"W x 68.8"H, perfectly storage for your closet, entryway, dormitory, apartments, garage, etc.

items.label: EASY ASSEMBLY
items.value: No tools needed, simply assemble the unit by hand with provided parts, quickly and brings you great convenience. You can also separate it into 2 5-tier racks.
